Name: Meowmere Weapons
Author: MissAnaira
Description:
A C#/CP mod that adds Meowmere club/hammer and dagger variants to the game. These weapons have the same rainbow kill effect as the Meowmere sword. You can purchase these weapons at the Adventurer's Guild from Marlon after obtaining [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Meowmere]Meowmere[/url]. This mod was made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MissAnaira]MissAnaira[/url] and coded by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ApryllForever/mods?gameId=1303]ApryllForever[/url]!

Thank you Apryll for taking the time to code this mod in C#!
